description: Defines classes and interfaces for Webm frame threading, including thread management, source and sink threads, and media source handling within the Android media framework.

classes.name: WebmFrameThread
classes.description: Abstract base class for Webm frame threading, providing thread control methods.

classes.name: WebmFrameSinkThread
classes.description: Handles writing Webm frames to output, acting as a sink in the threading model.

classes.name: WebmFrameSourceThread
classes.description: Abstract class for Webm frame source threads, providing interface for frame duration.

classes.name: WebmFrameEmptySourceThread
classes.description: A source thread that produces an end-of-stream signal immediately.

classes.name: WebmFrameMediaSourceThread
classes.description: A media source thread that reads frames from a MediaSource object.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the thread's main loop for processing frames.

methods.name: getDurationUs
methods.description: Returns the duration of the media in microseconds.
